[LTIM.2.2.1] `monotonic_ns()` returns the monotonic clock's current sample
([LTIM.2.8.2], [LTIM.2.8.4]) as a `Duration`. A later read never returns less
than an earlier one. The value's zero is unspecified, so only the difference of
two reads is meaningful. The runtime must not scale a microsecond reading into
the `Duration` — the `Duration` is already nanoseconds ([LTIM.1.3.1]).
